title: The Role of the Director: Duties and Collective Responsibility
summary: The legal duties a director owes, the different roles of executive, non-executive and independent directors and the chair, and how individual responsibility sits alongside the board's collective decision-making.
contentGaps: Written as part of a programme: Aim and Purpose is the module's one-line description; audience, prior knowledge and core reading come from the programme

sections.Aim and Purpose: The legal duties a director owes, the different roles of executive, non-executive and independent directors and the chair, and how individual responsibility sits alongside the board's collective decision-making.
Learning Objectives: Explain the core duties of a director and to whom they are owed
Compare the roles of executive, non-executive and independent directors
Balance individual responsibility with the board's collective accountability
Syllabus: Statutory and fiduciary duties: skill, care, diligence and acting in good faith
Is there a job description for a director of a fund or a management company?
Executive, non-executive, independent and chair roles on the board and its committees
Individual versus collective responsibility and protecting against liability
Intended Audience: Chairs, executive, non-executive and independent directors of regulated firms, fund boards and management companies
Senior managers preparing for a first board appointment or moving from an executive to a non-executive role
Company secretaries, heads of governance and compliance staff who support the board and its committees
sections.Useful Prior Knowledge and Experience: Board or senior management experience in financial services is helpful. No prior governance training is required.
Core Reading: IOSCO, Examination of Governance for Collective Investment Schemes (2006–2007)
FSB, Strengthening Governance Frameworks to Mitigate Misconduct Risk: A Toolkit for Firms and Supervisors (2018)
Olivier Sibony, You're About to Make a Terrible Mistake! How Biases Distort Decision-Making (2020)
